title: スプリンターズSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O is determined to make this race the turning point in her dash down the Bakushin Road…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is a race any sprinter dreams of winning… And she's set to cross paths with Nishino Flower, her strongest competition!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I see her off, praying for the best… and hoping this will let her compete in the following year faster than ever.
